# @sebastian-software/standards

[![Powered by Sebastian Software](https://img.shields.io/badge/Powered_by-Sebastian_Software-005164?style=flat)](https://oss.sebastian-software.com) [![CI](https://github.com/sebastian-software/standards/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/sebastian-software/standards/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-yellow.svg)](https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT)

Shared repository configuration and a small CLI for Sebastian Software projects.
It checks configuration drift, applies predictable file changes, and hands
migration steps that need a decision to a developer or coding agent.
The CLI has no runtime dependencies.

## Check an existing Node repository

Run from its repository root after installing its locked dependencies:

```sh
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm exec standards check
```

A clean repository exits `0`. If the installed CLI reports drift, preview the
migration before running it:

```sh
pnpm exec standards sync --dry-run
pnpm exec standards sync --agent codex
```

`sync` requires the selected agent on `PATH` (`claude` is the default).
Read-only previews and resumable sync require the release shipping standards
version 16 or newer. With that release, a failed migration keeps `.standards/pending.json`;
rerun the same command to resume. Review the resulting diff and run the
repository's checks before committing.

These commands use the **installed CLI version**. To adopt a newer release,
update the exact dependency pin and lockfile first, or use its Renovate PR.
See [update and recovery instructions](docs/cli.md#update-a-consumer).

## Three repositories, three responsibilities

- **standards** owns the CLI, reference files and numbered migrations.
- **[renovate-config](https://github.com/sebastian-software/renovate-config)**
  owns update discovery and shared Renovate rules.
- **[repo-template](https://github.com/sebastian-software/repo-template)**
  supplies the starting files for new repositories.

Consumers opt in through `.repometa.json` and the two Renovate presets.
[The model guide](docs/standards-model.md) explains which changes are automatic
and which need a migration decision.

## Contribute

Use Node 24 or newer and the pnpm version in `package.json`:

```sh
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm agent:check
```

The gate runs lint, formatting, type checking, build, tests and the repository's
own standards check. Source lives in `src/`; reference files in `reference/`.
Changes to consumer policy also need a numbered entry in `changes/` and a
`manifest.json#currentVersion` bump. CLI-only repairs do not need a policy bump.

For README edits, change `README.md.src` and follow
[README setup and generation](docs/readme-theme.md). Commit the generated
`README.md` with its source.
